vision: Low-magic Folk-Fantasy in the style of Celtic moorlands. Duskmoor is a vast, misty-damp high moor between rugged rock ridges and black peat lakes. The mood is melancholic, mysterious, and down-to-earth at the same time: hard, industrious Moorfolk villages on one side — the unpredictable, ancient fairy world of the "Hollow Court" on the other. Magic is rare, subtle, and dangerous. Tone: earthy, legendary, a hint of creepiness.

lore.title: History / Myth
lore.content: A thousand years ago, the kingdom of Aldmerrow sank in the "Great Rain" and became the moor. What remained are the Standing Stones — stone circles that are considered gates to the fairy world. The Moorfolk settled later, dug peat, and smelted bog iron. A fragile pact maintains peace with the Hollow Court: one only takes from the moor what it freely gives.

lore.title: Geography
lore.content: The High Moor: endless heathlands, peat cuttings, black lakes, fog banks. The Grey Teeth: isolated rock ridges and cliffs with caves. The Standing Stones: scattered stone circles, glowing at night. Peat Villages: small settlements of dark wood and fieldstone.

lore.title: Factions / Peoples
lore.content: The Moorfolk — farmers, peat cutters, iron smiths. Tough, superstitious, hospitable. The Hollow Court — fairy beings; beautiful and cruel, bound by rules and pacts. The Iron Wardens — half militia, half priestly order; protect the villages from what comes out of the mist.

lore.title: Legends / Artifacts
lore.content: The Mistglass — shimmering fairy-glass shards that show paths through the mist. The Peat King — a figure preserved in the moor; whoever awakens him reaps favor or curse.

rules.name: Standing Stone Marker Placement
effects: Can only be placed on rock/fieldstone, not peat
rules.description: Standing Stone Markers can only be placed on rock or fieldstone surfaces, not on peat.

rules.name: Night Dangers
rules.description: At night, Will-o'-Wisps appear, and Bog Hounds become aggressive.

rules.name: Enhanced Mistward Draught
effects: Mistward Draught effect lasts twice as long
rules.description: The effect of Mistward Draught is doubled when near Standing Stones.

rules.name: Moor Harvest Pact
effects: Angers the Hollow Court (triggers an event)
rules.description: Excessive harvesting from the moor will anger the Hollow Court, potentially triggering negative events.

environment.weather: Predominantly fog and drizzle, rarely clear twilight; occasionally "Moorlights" (cold aurora) at night.
environment.dayNight: Long blue twilights; night is dangerous (see rules).
environment.seasons: Mild, wet spring/autumn; harsh, frozen winter (moor lakes bear weight).
environment.backdrop: Flat horizon, fog banks, silhouettes of Standing Stones.
